props.text: Cycle-time fixture (issue #117) — machine cycles with phases from 12 s down to 40 ms, seeded around NOW on view load. config.zooms offers millisecond / second / minute / hour / day; the view opens at 'second'. The board is read-only, so bars render at their true width (no grabbable floor): the 40 ms 'Vent' and 60 ms 'Arc on/off' phases are hairlines at 'second' and readable at 'millisecond'.

transforms.code:
# Cycle-time fixture (issue #117): one machine cycle per station, repeated over
	# the last and next ten minutes, with phases that last seconds — and some that
	# last a fraction of a second, so the 'second' preset has something to show.
	# now(0) = seeded once per view load, relative to the moment the view opened.
	# Emitted WITH the offset (absolute instants): a naive time would be read as
	# browser wall clock, and the gateway container's zone (UTC by default) is
	# not the operator's — at this zoom a two-hour skew empties the board.
	t0 = system.date.addMinutes(value, -10)
	def iso(d):
		return system.date.format(d, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX")
	def at(ms):
		return system.date.addMillis(t0, int(ms))
	out = []
	def ev(eid, res, title, s_ms, e_ms, cat, **kw):
		row = {"id": eid, "resourceId": res, "title": title, "start": iso(at(s_ms)), "end": iso(at(e_ms)), "category": cat}
		row.update(kw)
		out.append(row)
	# Station A: 20 s cycle. Station B: 12 s cycle with an occasional fault.
	# Several phases are deliberately SUB-SECOND (down to 40 ms) so the
	# millisecond preset has something only it can resolve: at 'second' zoom a
	# 40 ms phase is 0.5 px, at 'millisecond' it is 6 px.
	cycles = {
		"stationA": [("Clamp", 2500, "move"), ("Latch", 120, "move"), ("Inject", 4000, "process"),
			("Cool", 11740, "process"), ("Vent", 40, "move"), ("Eject", 1500, "move")],
		"stationB": [("Pick", 800, "move"), ("Settle", 180, "move"), ("Place", 600, "move"),
			("Arc on", 60, "process"), ("Weld", 9100, "process"), ("Arc off", 60, "process"),
			("Inspect", 1200, "check")],
	}
	span_ms = 20 * 60 * 1000
	for res, phases in cycles.items():
		period = sum(p[1] for p in phases)
		n = 0
		t = 0
		while t < span_ms:
			off = 0
			for (name, dur, cat) in phases:
				ev("%s-%d-%s" % (res, n, name.lower()), res, name, t + off, t + off + dur, cat)
				off += dur
			# every 7th cycle of station B stalls in a fault for 6 seconds
			if res == "stationB" and n % 7 == 6:
				ev("%s-%d-fault" % (res, n), res, "FAULT", t + period, t + period + 6000, "down", display="state",
					description="Stall - the state band is 6 s long.")
				t += 6000
			t += period
			n += 1
	# Machine-state bands for station A: RUNNING the whole span.
	ev("stateA", "stationA", "RUNNING", 0, span_ms, "run", display="state")
	return out
